Item #: SCP-[REDACTED] (working designation: LACUNA)
Object Class: Euclid

Special Containment Procedures: LACUNA's source is housed in Cell A-07 of the Containment Wing. The cell is to be kept free of staff entry. Cell A-07 is monitored by a sealed observation loop; the loop is to be treated as a hazard in its own right (see Addendum 1).

Description: LACUNA is an informational anomaly. Persons within the affected zone cease to exist in all records: logs, badge histories, photographs, and the memories of other staff. Physical bodies are not recovered. Affected zones expand while recording equipment inside them remains active.

Addendum 1: Review of the initial incident shows the effect does not advance in zones where recording devices are offline. Loss of observation reduces situational awareness and should be weighed against containment.

Addendum 2: Door authorisations are tied to personnel records. As records erode, seals on affected sectors may fail.
